headline: Trump Coal Subsidies Cost U.S. Taxpayers Billions, Assessments Find
summary: Federal measures to prevent retiring U.S. coal power plants from closing have cost taxpayers billions of dollars in federal funds, according to recent assessments.
why: Government subsidies and interventions in the energy sector affect power generation economics, taxpayer obligations, and the pace of the clean energy transition.

impacts.name: US coal power sector
impacts.why: Federal funding and intervention prevented scheduled coal plant retirements.
